pipeline: Kimodo SOMA-RP-v1.2 text generation -> direct original-biped anatomical retarget
prompt: A person takes a short run-up and jumps lightly over a low obstacle, landing smoothly on both feet.

case.prompt: A person takes a short run-up and jumps lightly over a low obstacle, landing smoothly on both feet.

generation.scope: Real text-conditioned generation; finite arrays do not establish foot contact, balance or visual quality.

limitations: New target-proportion adaptations need fresh visual review.
Original Kimodo motion is preserved; only a constant target bind-floor calibration is applied.
No target contact IK, obstacle collision or balance solver in this baseline.
Target proportions differ from the performer
One constant retargeted-neutral floor offset is disclosed; different proportions may skate or intersect the floor
No hand/foot pinning or armor self-collision solve
Fingers remain at original rig rest pose; source hand detail is not reproduced
Not a MotionBricks-generated clip, not a G1 CSV, not physical robot control
status: experimental direct original-biped retarget; requires motion/contact review
root_motion: MOTION owns horizontal displacement only; PELVIS holds full orientation including inversion. No yaw extraction singularity during a roll. Place the entire glTF scene in an instance wrapper.
ground_policy: Constant retargeted-neutral floor calibration only, retained across every frame. Source vertical travel and jump flight are scaled and retained. No target foot IK or per-frame body-floor clamp.
